# anthropic_service_account_workspace (Resource)

Manages an explicit workspace membership for a non-human Anthropic service account (`/v1/organizations/service_accounts/{service_account_id}/workspaces`). Requires an `org:admin` OAuth access token (`oauth_token`) or `federation` authentication. Granting workspace membership is required before a service account with `organization_role = "user"` can mint workspace-scoped OAuth tokens via Workload Identity Federation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_account_id` (String) ID of the service account (`svac_...`).
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace (`wrkspc_...`).
- `workspace_role` (String) Role of the service account within the workspace (`workspace_user`, `workspace_developer`, `workspace_restricted_developer`, `workspace_admin`).

### Read-Only

- `created_by_actor_id` (String) ID of the actor that created the workspace membership, or `null` for implicit memberships.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format `<service_account_id>/<workspace_id>`.
- `implicit` (Boolean) Whether the membership is derived implicitly from the service account's `organization_role`.
- `type` (String) Object type (`service_account_workspace_member`).
